# Quantifying the Improvement of Gated Recurrent Neural Tensor Networks over Standard Gated RNN Baselines

## Introduction

The Gated Recurrent Neural Tensor Network (RNTN) paper introduces two hybrid recurrent architectures that fuse the gating mechanism of modern recurrent networks with the bilinear tensor-product interaction previously used in recursive neural tensor networks ([Tjandra et al., 2017](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.02222)).
